title: Heal
direction: Maintain a soft background field and let stronger pulses briefly raise density. Avoid sharp, frequent accents. The rain should feel suspended in a larger atmosphere.

sections.name: haze: opening
sections.note: A soft field carries frequent measured note marks and broad phrase pulses. Measured note patterns carry the main surface; incidental weather is held behind them.
